name: Cengage UI Style Guide
des: A customized Bootstrap-based web style guide and living documentation site for Cengage Learning. It establishes front-end standards including a responsive 12-column grid, typography, forms, navigation components, breadcrumbs, tabbed interfaces, and integrated video players, enabling consistent and accessible development across Cengage's educational platforms.
mission: Front-end Developer, UI system analysis and responsive component design
technology: HTML5, CSS3, LESS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, Font Awesome, Responsive Design

name: Oracle Workbench
des: An interactive documentation and management workbench for Oracle-based content cartridge and template systems used across educational publishing platforms. Built as a multi-client AngularJS single-page application, it provides searchable and filterable lists of cartridges, detailed views showing templates, sections, editable fields, and descriptions, plus image galleries and modal previews for National Geographic, Cengage, and Nelson projects.
mission: Front-end Developer, AngularJS application development, UI system analysis and interactive documentation dashboard design
technology: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, Bootstrap, ngRoute, ngResource, jQuery, Responsive Design

name: Cross CHX Dashboard
des: An interactive healthcare analytics dashboard for cardiology and cardiac surgery at Oxford General Medical Center. Built as an AngularJS single-page application, it features D3.js visualizations for patient visits, insurance breakdowns, and demographic maps, along with searchable lists and detailed profiles for physicians and patients, plus dedicated views for activity, complaints, diagnoses, and medications.
mission: Front-end Developer, AngularJS application development, D3 data visualization, and healthcare dashboard UI design
technology: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, D3.js, ngRoute, ngResource, Polymer, Google Maps, Material Icons, Responsive Design
